annotation.interpretation_a: An endpoint is required to create the HTTP control stream and mandatory extension streams, but is not required to create additional streams.
annotation.interpretation_b: An endpoint is encouraged to create the HTTP control stream and mandatory extension streams, and is also encouraged to create additional streams if resources allow.
annotation.justification: The use of 'SHOULD' creates ambiguity. It is unclear whether the endpoint is required to create the streams or merely encouraged to do so. This affects implementation because a strict interpretation would require creation, while a lenient one would only encourage it.
